fills.researcher_notes: The sheet's 177.00 km is the same double-conversion bug found on P1856/P1857 in this cluster. OPEC ASB Table 4.10 (opec.org PDFs dead on the live site; recovered via Wayback + pdftotext per the protocol's gotcha; url_verifier FAILs on both PDFs because it can't substring-match compressed PDF text streams -- a known false-negative, manually confirmed by me) lists: ASB2012 (2011 data) 'Waha/Nasser, Waha, 110, 24in, 5,664,118' under a column headed '(miles)'; ASB2013 (2012 data) restates the same route as '68.2' under a column that IS genuine miles (68.2 x 1.609 = 109.75 km, matching ASB2012's raw '110' almost exactly). As established on P1856 (using the well-documented 540 km Greenstream pipeline in the same table as ground truth), ASB2012's 'miles' header is mislabeled -- those values are already in km. So the true sourced length is ~110 km, and the sheet's 177.00 km = 110 x 1.609, i.e. GEM re-applied a miles-to-km conversion to a value that was already in km. Proposing LengthKnownKm=110. Note the drawn route (69.9 km) is still short of even the corrected 110 km (ratio 0.64, still below the 0.75 tolerance floor) -- closer than the 0.39 ratio against 177 km, but not fully resolved; recommend the route also be reviewed (see validity note) even though the length fix is the primary and better-evidenced correction.

Ecofin Agency (Dec 2025, verified live, contains 'Waha') confirms Waha Oil Company -- a joint venture of NOC, TotalEnergies and ConocoPhillips, matching the sheet's Owner field exactly -- operates the Farigh/Nasser Sirte-basin gas fields this line serves. OPEC ASB Table 4.10 (same recovered-PDF source cited for the length fill above) independently lists owner/operator 'Waha' for the Waha/Nasser route, corroborating the value, but I'm not double-counting that as a second independent source here since it's the same document family already cited for the length fix on this row. Tier medium: one genuinely distinct non-OPEC source found and verified before the session's WebSearch budget was exhausted.

No sourced commissioning year found for this specific gas line. OPEC ASB Table 4.10 (2011 data, recovered via Wayback + pdftotext) already lists 'Waha/Nasser' as an existing, operating, capacity-reporting line by end-2011, so it was commissioned no later than 2011 -- an upper bound only, not an answer. Waha Oil Company's Sirte-basin fields (Waha field discovered 1961 per Wikipedia's Sirte Basin article, verified) date the general concession back decades, but per the protocol a field's first-production year is not the pipeline's commissioning year, and no source ties a specific year to this 24in/110km gas line itself. Marking UNRESOLVED rather than guessing; same dead end as P1857 and P1861 in this cluster.

validity.recommendation: After correcting LengthKnownKm to 110 km (per the fill above), the drawn route (69.9 km) still falls short by more than the length_ratio tolerance (0.64 vs the 0.75 floor). Recommend a human re-check/redraw the route rather than treating the length fix alone as fully closing this flag.
